classifier_only.score_definition: CNN-LSTM attack probability; higher means more likely attack

vae_only.score_definition: VAE anomaly score; higher means more anomalous

hybrid_cascade.score_definition: Cascade ranking: classifier-positive samples rank above all others; classifier-negative samples are ranked by VAE anomaly score. Equivalent to sweeping the VAE gate threshold while keeping the classifier threshold fixed.

hybrid_saved_operating_point.score_definition: Original saved 0/1 Hybrid cascade prediction at calibrated thresholds

interpretation_note: Classifier-only AUC and VAE-only AUC evaluate individual branches. hybrid_cascade AUC evaluates a ranking of the complete cascade under a fixed classifier threshold and a swept VAE gate threshold. Do not call classifier-only AUC the AUC of the complete Hybrid.
